text:
marie: Heads up — planning a New On‑Call Onboarding + Shadowing wave next week (Mon–Thu). Goal: get 2 new folks into rotations as shadows, with clear handoffs and runbook walkthroughs. I need volunteers to be primary/secondary mentors and a couple of people to run the paging simulation. :wave:

aj: I can shadow Mon–Wed mornings (9:00–12:00 PT). How do I get page access + where are the runbooks?

leo: I can be primary Mon/Tue. rita — can you be secondary Mon/Tue? I’ll take Wed afternoon handoff notes for whoever shadows.

rita: yeah I’m in for Mon/Tue secondary. Thu looks like a gap right now (no one signed up night shift) — we should call that out.

oncall-bot: Rotation posted: Leo (primary) Mon/Tue, Rita (secondary) Mon/Tue, Sam (primary) Wed, open Thu night. To see coverage: `oncall status` or https://redwood.internal/rota

marie: Runbooks are here: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/oncall-index and the new-joiner guide: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/oncall-new-hire. Shadowing checklist (short):
- join primary on-call Slack channel and calls
- watch PagerDuty pages and watch triage flow
- go through "Escalation & Communication" runbook page
- at end of each shift, primary writes a 1–2 line handoff note in the oncall channel and pins it

sam: Also add the noisy-alert filter step to the first runbook page. Quick snippet to ignore test alerts locally:```
# temporary local suppress (use only in shadow/test)
kubectl annotate svc alert-proxy suppress=test-shadow-$(whoami) --overwrite
```

leo: Escalation steps I'll be using with shadows (copy this into the runbook):
```
1) Confirm alert > check dashboards (grafana/redwood-infer)
2) If P1/P2, page SRE-lead pager (PD escalation) 
   `pd escalate --incident $INC --to SRE-lead`
3) Create incident stub: `/incident create --sev {1|2} --svc inference --short "<one-line>"` in #incidents
4) Post customer-impact estimate in channel (approx tokens/sec / affected customers)
5) If unsure, call for lead in #eng-oncall with @here
```

aj: Thanks — can we do a paging simulation during a shadow? I'd like to practice the flow without impacting customers.

marie: Yes — scheduled a simulated page for Monday 09:00 PT. Command for test pages (only run by mentors): `pd trigger --test --tag onboarding-shadow`. It creates a simulated incident with no customer impact, posted by incident-bot. Please do not run outside scheduled windows. Calendar invite: https://calendar.internal/event/slug/oncall-shadow-2026

incident-bot: Simulated incident created: INC-2026-045-test (test only) — triggered by marie. No customer impact. Use this for shadowing.

marie: Handoff process reminder: primary writes a short note at end of their shift with: who was shadowing, any open alerts, and any config changes. Template: `Handoff: primary=leo, secondary=rita, shadow=aj, open_alerts=none, notes=ran paging simulation, follow-ups: #1234` — then pin the note.

rita: I'll pick up the pinned notes routine. Also volunteer to run the Thu night gap if no one else signs up, but prefer we get another volunteer first.

sam: I'll run the noisy-alert portion of the runbook update + lead the test page on Mon if needed.

marie: Awesome. Action items:
- leo/rita: confirm primary/secondary on the rota (done)
- sam: update runbook noisy-alert snippet before Mon 08:00 PT
- marie: send calendar invites + create test incident
- aj: join PD and Slack channel access by EOD Fri; DM me if you don't have access

aj: got it — will verify PD access and ping if blocked. :thumbsup:

leo: one more note — when shadowing, mute non-urgent low-priority alerts so it’s not overwhelming. We’ll teach triage rules in the first 30m.

marie: Perfect. Thanks everyone — will post final schedule + invite shortly and pin the onboarding runbook in this channel. :sparkles:
